sh settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1
sh am broadcast -a android.intent.action.CLOSE_SYSTEM_DIALOGS >/dev/null
sh am force-stop com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox
sh am force-stop com.android.chrome
sh am force-stop com.brave.browser
stop
wait 2
launch
wait 12
taploop (?i)^(skip for now|allow|while using the app|only this time|ok)$
taploop (?i)^(allow|while using the app|only this time|ok|continue|get started|next|skip|not now|got it|accept|agree|done|start)$
shot 30-relaunch
tap (?i)^(talk|walkie.talkie)$
wait 4
shot 31-talk-tab
sh logcat -d -s DirectBilling
